title: UnlinkIdentity
description: The body of a request to unlink an external identity from the caller's own account, derived from identity_application::accounts::UnlinkIdentity. It carries no actor and no user_id: a user may only unlink from their own account, and the field that would let them name someone else's is the one this layer refuses to have.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; UnlinkIdentityCommand has no body and no route serves it

identity_id.description: The identity's identifier — the enrollment row's id, NOT the (provider, subject) pair. The pair is what a provider calls the user; this is what we call the link.
identity_id.x-type-note: A plain String in the Rust type, not the IdentityId newtype. The domain's IdentityId is a transparent UUID newtype, so a well-formed value is the canonical hyphenated text form — but the field itself is a String and this schema does not claim the compiler enforces the shape.

x-on-refusal.last-sign-in-method: ApplicationError::Domain. Unlinking the last sign-in method of an account is a self-lockout, and this refusal is the only thing standing between a compromised session and an unreachable account.
x-on-refusal.not-at-aal2: ApplicationError::Domain. The session must be at AAL2. Removing a way to authenticate is not something an AAL1 session may do.
x-on-refusal.phase: Phase 3 — the AAL2 requirement; Phase 5 — the surface

x-phase: Phase 3 — Second factor, and the assurance model for the AAL2 requirement; Phase 5 — Applications, grants, and the self-service surface for the surface
